BERRY BURY BERRY
Vibe: What if Don't Hug Me I'm Scared was a video game

Your job is to put berries in a hole. The sun has a face. There are gnomes watching you. When it's nighttime, you sleep beneath a giant, hypnotising piggybank who is always watching you.

Fun!

FORTUNE SELLER
Vibe: You are Resi 4's merchant

What are ya sellin'? A bunch of weird arcane items, which you'll have to fit perfectly into the small grid of your customer's bag if you want to make enough money to not be CONSUMED BY SOMETHING ELDRITCH

OUTBOUND
Vibe: Van life, but you gotta make everything yourself out of shit you found in the woods

The crafting-and-travel of Raft, but instead of a raft, it's a van, and there's no shark. Pick up materials, and upgrade your van until it's basically a one-vehicle glamping experience.

HARVENTURE
Vibe: Choppy clicky. Clicky choppy. Yaaay

A relatively simple incremental clicker (i.e. a Numbers Go Up Slowly game) but with really nice art. You chop trees and mine rocks, then buy new abilities in a skill tree. Repeat until satisfied

SCRIPTORIUM
Vibe: Egg horse penis face simulator

You are a nun. People ask you to make them pictures. But your only tools are medieval drawings, and they're... hmm... not great. But you can make them great! Although, more realistically, you'll just draw penises, won't you? Good. Correct.

ELDOR'IDLE
Vibe: What if Zelda was ONLY about smashing pots

A simple clicker-type game with a sense of humour. You smash pots to get money. Orrr you can hire gnomes to do it, but they'll probably steal from you. Great pixel art, too!

MAP MAP: A GAME ABOUT MAPS
Vibe: map mapmap map mapmap

Map out an island using only context clues! Cute idea, charmingly goofy (all the dialogue is VOed with "mapmapmapmap")

FORBIDDEN SOLITAIRE
Vibe: What if the Windows Maze Screensaver was haunted

...and also, Solitaire? It's got the same mechanics as Regency Solitaire (same developer) plus the crunchy '90s graphics of the Dancing Baby GIF. And also, the meta-layer of "oh no this game is haunted", which is always fun.

ENTER THE CHRONOSPHERE
Vibe: Superhot timey-wimeyness with psychedelic visuals

It's really nice to see a game as confident about its own unique style as this one. Time only moves when you do, so your position and aim become a strategy of expectations. Plus there's a bear astronaut!
